text: Learning activities let you explore ideas, make mistakes and compare your reasoning with guidance. Your practice is different from a formal assessment. Before a knowledge check, read the stated pass mark, attempt limits and feedback rules. A reviewed tick does not prove competence, and a prepared draft is not an assessor's decision. Follow the assessment instructions provided for your course.
